answer: In an agent marketplace, every bidder, whether composing a sonnet or designing a terrace, must lock 100 tokens in a vault for 30 days before submitting bids, with one active bid allowed per deposit. Creating extra identities grants no free bidding capacity: flooding a job with 1,000 bids requires locking 100,000 tokens. The attacker can recover the principal later, but loses access to that capital for a month and bears its financing cost.
